blocks.text: To write to a file, open it in write mode (w) and use the write () method. To append data, use append mode (a).

#    Writing to a file
with open("example.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!\n")
#    Appending to a file
with open("example.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("Appending new line.\n")

items: The file is opened in write mode (w) to overwrite its contents and write new data.
The file is opened in append mode (a) to add data without overwriting existing content.
